intro: Hello, this is my space where I write and make things because I feel like it, you know: design and waste time. Some examples:
narrativas.title: Football Narratives
narrativas.desc: A small fictional construction that imagines and raves, above all, about the problems plaguing Colombian professional football.
sancocho.title: Sancocho Vallenato
sancocho.desc: A kind of philosophical-musical bestiary that portrays the naive fools who fill the pernicious corners of the Colombian Caribbean.
mixtape.title: The City Isn't That Rotten
mixtape.desc: Medellín punk mixtape #1: no Spotify, no algorithms, pure decay.
museo.title: Museo de la Memoria Corregida
museo.desc: Works removed by decree, shown again.
